messages:
maya: OK team — webinar on Apr 10 needs a small bench pack for the live demo. We want: quantized/FP16 variants, warm vs cold start numbers, tail latency (99/99.9), and a tiny transcript-level sample we can use on stage. Can runtime run smoke + reproducible artifacts? :pray:

leo: @maya got it. timeline? and which models/configs are priority?

maya: timeline is EOD Wed for numbers we can use in slides. Priority: llama-3-7B-q4_0 (quantized), llama-3-7B-fp16, and a fast-oracle smaller model for interactive demo. Include embedding throughput too (50k token batch sim).

sam: we can do this. I'll run a focused sweep on dedicated infra (nv4p) w/ these knobs: 1) cold boot (empty cache) 10 samples, 2) warm (prefill 512 tokens) 50 samples, 3) 1-token streaming vs full-generation. Will output raw tsv + run manifest. ETA: 18h.

maya: perfect. Can you also capture per-token cost estimate and a single sample output for creative QA? Need one 'showcase' generation that looks sane.

sam: yes. One more ask: do you want deterministic seeds for the showcase? we can fix rand seeds + temperature 0.7.

maya: please yes — determinism helps QA. Also add an artifact for 'model fallback' where quantized fails to load and we fall back to fp16 — want example latency hit.

sam: noted. Starting runs now. I'll push artifacts to s3://redwood-marketing/benchpacks/webinar/1708543210/ and post manifest here when done.

eng-runtime-bot: [deploy] bench-run started by sam on nv4p. job_id=run-7821. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/run-7821

ana: quick QA ask — can marketing get a small README with the 'single sentence' interpretation of the numbers (eg: "~2.4x faster cold than baseline at 2k tokens, quantized cost -35%") so we don't overclaim?

sam: will include a 2-line executive summary per model + raw numbers. Also embedding throughput measured as queries/sec and p99.

maya: thanks. If you hit any flaky examples, ping me with one-liners. :raised_hands:

sam: manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-marketing/benchpacks/webinar/1708543210/manifest.json
sample curl to pull a single artifact:

``
curl -o sample-output.json "https://s3.internal/redwood-marketing/benchpacks/webinar/1708543210/sample-llama3-7b-q4.json"
``

sam: I'll post final numbers + executive blurbs in this thread when complete.

leo: will check perf dashboards and confirm no noisy neighbors on the machines. If anything looks off I'll requeue.

maya: appreciate it all — will slot these into talk deck once we have the executive blurbs. :sparkles:
